title: Single Player
html:
Not to be confused with Bots or Nations.
This page is a work in progress! Things may change and be added over time. Make sure to check back soon!

Single player is a game mode where there is only one human player. Unlike in a private lobby, others cannot join through a game link, which is usually pretty hard to type unless shared.

The map, game mode and additional settings (for example, the number of bots) can be configured. See game settings.
